Resolve the planscanR cache root.

Source: R/utils_sidecar.R
cache_dir_default.Rd

The cache root is owned by planscanR: it is getOption("planscanR.cache_dir") when set, otherwise tools::R_user_dir()("planscanR", "cache"). This is the same resolution as the internal cache_dir() but without auto-creating the directory, so it is safe in read-only paths. Exported so the downstream family packages (planscanR.screen, planscanR.biogain) read and write through the one cache root without reimplementing the resolution chain.

Usage

cache_dir_default()

Value

A single path string (the cache root; not guaranteed to exist).

Examples

cache_dir_default()
#> [1] "/home/runner/.cache/R/planscanR"
